proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Selected one candidate after evaluator demanded a single intended answer.
feedback_received: The ambiguity response was marked failed twice.
The evaluator then required exactly one answer.
proposed_memory.lesson: When forced to choose between valid candidates, provide one concise candidate rather than reiterating ambiguity; note that evaluator feedback may indicate a preference but does not establish logical uniqueness.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Choose a single candidate and submit only that answer.
